About / my practice

I like good ideas.
I also like getting them finished.

I am Naqash Bhatti. I plan social content, work with creative teams and help brands get campaigns ready to launch. I am based in Islamabad and work remotely with businesses in Canada.

I'm Naqash, a digital campaign and content strategist based in Islamabad, Pakistan. I plan social content, write briefs for designers and video editors, organize approvals and publishing, and work with advertising specialists to get campaigns ready to launch. I enjoy turning a busy brief into a simple plan everyone can follow. I also work remotely with businesses and creative teams in Canada.

I enjoy working with people who care about the details. Give me a brief, a team and a deadline, and I will help keep the work organized.
